Project trust account eligibility criteria:

  1. You're a head contractor or a related entity sub contractor engaged by a contracting party applicable to current phase
  2. The contract price is as per the relevant phase
  3. More than 50 per cent of the contract price is for project trust work
  4. You are engaging one or more subcontractors

If all of the eligibility criteria is met (and no exemptions apply), you must use a project trust account for the project.
